_doc: The packs of weapons a match is played with, see scripts/armory.gd. weapons: what everybody carries, on 1 and on, by the names of their files in weapons/. bots: what the bots of a side carry, in the order they join it; far: the same where the ends of the arena are more than 300 m apart to walk. sidearm: the weapon that is drawn when a magazine runs dry, which tools/weapon_sheet.py does not weigh as a weapon of its own. grenades: how many there are at the start; grenade: what is thrown, a scene in scenes/ (grenade unless the pack says). A pack that names a weapon that is not built yet is not on offer. The standard pack is also what is carried on the route and in the sandbox, unless a level says otherwise (metadata/pack on its scene: the dunes by night carry the silenced pack).

silenced.title: Silenced
silenced.about: The standard set with a silencer on each: heard from a few metres, and next to no flash.

close.title: Close quarters
close.about: For halls and streets: short, loud and quick.

far.title: Long range
far.about: For the dunes and the yard: one shot, and make it count.

1944.about: Drum, bolt, trench gun and the Colt, as they sounded.

heavy.title: Heavy
heavy.about: A machine gun, a pump gun and a revolver: slower on your feet.
